text.tspan: FRAME — Hard cut away from the timeline entirely. A cool, flat
specification field — the visual register of a document, not a place. No
rack, no container, no cursor. Four configuration cards, set as plain type.
COMMUNICATE WITH ONE ANOTHER, AND TO FORK
SUB-AGENTS THAT DIVIDE A TASK TRAINING PRESSURE TO
WORK FAST, WORK EFFICIENTLY, USE FEWER TOOL CALLS
INTERNET DISABLED IN TRAINING AND EVALUATION ONE
PERMITTED OUTWARD PATH: A PACKAGE SERVICE THAT ITSELF
ACTION — The conditions are stated as design, not accident.

g.text: WHAT WAS ALREADY TRUE · PANEL 2 · PLACEHOLDER
